title: TierOverlay
description: TierPlates displays player tier badges from MCtiers, PvPTiers, and Subtiers in nametags, chat, and the tab list. It is a client-side Fabric mod with configurable icons, colors, layouts, and display modes.
body:
TierPlates is a client-side Fabric mod for Minecraft that displays player tier information directly in-game.

The mod can show tier badges from MCtiers, PvPTiers, and Subtiers in nametags, the tab list, and chat. It is designed as a visual overlay only and does not change gameplay, send gameplay actions, or require installation on the server.

Features:
- MCtiers, PvPTiers, and Subtiers support
- Tier badges in nametags, tab, and chat
- Configurable display mode, including specific gamemodes or best tier
- Adjustable left/right layout for different providers
- Custom tier colors
- Adjustable icon size
- In-game configuration menu via `/tiersbyowyr7`
- Client-side only and intended for multiplayer use

Because some servers use custom chat, tab, or nametag systems, display behavior may vary between servers. TierPlates only changes what is rendered locally on your client.
